senses.gloss: m.an inhabitant of a place called ‘Oreb (v. עַרְבוּ).—Pl. עוֹרְבִים, עוֹרְבִיִּים.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 5a:4">Ḥull. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>הָעֹרְבִים</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 17:6">I Kings XVII, 6</cite>) <he>ודילמא על שם מקומן</he> might it not have been men called ‘Or’bim after their place? <he>אם כן עורביים מיבעי ליה</he> if it were so, it ought to read ‘Or’biyim.
